wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-01/03 seats Theocritus's Idylls entire as verified parsable primary text in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's corpus program. Fetched commit-pinned from Perseus canonical-greekLit (tlg0005, Cholmeley's edition over a public-domain base), the corpus is normalized to 2,692 ref-tagged lines addressable as idyll and line, with as-fetched originals, a source manifest recording edition and license, and a SHA-256 manifest. Verification was performed against the Ω erratum program's own loci: Idyll 2.82, Simaetha's triple correlative χὡς ἴδον, ὡς ἐμάνην, and 2.88, the dye-plant color-station χρὼς ὁμοῖος θάψῳ — both stations of the frozen operator. The seat is governed by the EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 work plan and joins Josephus and Catullus in the seated primary-text base underlying the program's transform analyses.
